verses.gurmukhi: ੧੭ : ਮਨ ਜਿਤ ਆਪ ਜਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ
verses.translit_en: 17 : man jit aap jit saadh sa(n)g

en.bdb: The world is conquered only by conquering the mind ,  ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham aadh purakh hai satigur soiee|

en.bdb: Transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm; He is the primal cosmic spirit (purakh) and the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: jog dhiaan hairaan hoi vedh giaan paravaeh na hoiee|

en.bdb: Yogis became awestruck in meditation for He does not care for knowledge of the Vedas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਭਵਦੀ ਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev sarevadhe jal thal maheeal bhavadhee loiee|

en.bdb: Adoring the gods and goddesses, people go on roaming (in different lives) in water on earth and in the sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: hom jag jap tap ghane kar kar karam dharam dhukh roiee|

en.bdb: They perform many burnt offerings, oblations and ascetic disciplines and still weep while performing the so-called ritualistic activities (because their sufferings are not removed).

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਅਠੁ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vas na aavai dhaavadhaa aTh kha(n)dd paakha(n)dd vigoiee|

en.bdb: Ever-running mind does not come under control and the mind has spoiled all the eight divisions of life (four varnas and four ashrams).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh man jin jag jinai aap gavai aape sabh koiee|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs after conquering the mind have won the whole world and losing their ego, they have seen themselves in one and all.
The gurmukhs have prepared the garland of virtues in the holy congregation.
